text:
sara: Alert: p95 jumped ~12% across serving-runtime around 00:12 UTC. Started after the 00:09 deploy. Dashboard: https://dash/reports/serving-runtime?p=last_2h :eyes:
ops-bot: Alert created INC-7123 — service/serving-runtime p95 > SLO.
david: Oncall — can we confirm which merge landed at 00:09?
lee: quick lookup: PR #458 merged by @mike at 00:08:52 UTC — commit abc123. Summary: "kernel-selector: add timeout-weight + small batching tweak"
lee: git log excerpt:
```
commit abc123 (HEAD -> main, origin/main)
Author: mike
Date:   2026-02-14 00:08:52 +0000

    kernel-selector: add timeout-weight + coalesce tweak
```
julia: I ran the perf harness against that commit locally. p95 regresses when a kernel handoff happens inside a batch boundary — profiler shows big memcpy spikes on kernel_choice path. Snippet:
```
[perf] kernel_choice: memcpy 12.4ms (hot)
[perf] batch_coalesce: wait 0.8ms
[perf] kv_cache_miss: increment
```
oliver: correlating infra metrics: kv_miss/sec spiked ~3x at same time window, eviction rate up. Query used: `promql: rate(kv_misses_total[1m])` — see graph: https://dash/metrics/kv_misses?range=20m
sara: If canary shows the same, we should revert the change on canary and hold the rollout. Can someone run a canary revert? :hand:
david: I'm on it — starting revert on canary now. Command: `/deploy revert --app serving-runtime --target canary --commit abc123`
ops-bot: deploy-bot: Revert started for serving-runtime (canary). Estimated 4m.
lee: Revert finished on canary. Quick smoke: synthetic load p95 back to baseline within 2 windows.
julia: Confirming profiler post-revert: memcpy hotpath gone, kv_miss/sec returned to normal. Seems the timeout-weight change nudged kernel selector to pick a slower path that triggers memcpy-heavy transition when batch sizes vary.
david: I'll open an immediate revert PR (revert PR #458) and pin to previous stable for the remainder of the rollout. Also filing follow-up: add unit/regression test for kernel handoff under varying batch sizes + CI perf check.
sara: Thanks — action items: david = revert PR, julia = perf postmortem + profiler traces, lee = add regression test & CI perf job. I'll hold the main rollout until we have the revert merged and canary validated. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: INC-7123 resolved (canary revert stabilized).
